title: On Consisting three short lines only
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：consist　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consist 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the report ① consisted three short lines only for the whole place, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the report ② consists three short lines only without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ consist three short lines only at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ consisted three short lines only before — a line in the poster for August 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Consisting three short lines only for the whole place, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the report ever ⑥ consists of one word and a date without a word of thanks before the August rains, nobody in the theatre would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ consist of one word and a date without a word of thanks and never speak of it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a second report ⑧ consists of one word and a date for the whole place every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the theatre said a word; ⑨ The report consisted three short lines only again in 1981, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To consist three short lines only, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, the report consists three short lines only without a word of thanks again and the report must consist three short lines only for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 包含（一般过去式 consisted three short lines only：1971 年那份报告头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 包含（一般现在 consists three short lines only：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 包含（不定式 to consist three short lines only：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 包含（过去完成时 had consisted three short lines only：1965 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 包含（动名词 consisting three short lines only 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 出在（consists of one word and a date：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真出在就一个词和一个日期）
G. v. 出在（consist of one word and a date：let it 之后的原形，指随它去就一个词和一个日期）
H. v. 包含（后段两处：后来的那份报告照例 consists of one word and a date，而那份报告在 1981 年又一次 consisted three short lines only）

items.q: to consist three short lines only
consisted three short lines only before
consists of one word and a date without a word of thanks
consist of one word and a date without a word of thanks and
consists of one word and a date for the whole place
consisted three short lines only again
to consist three short lines only

answers.why: consist 意为“包含”，1971 年那份报告替所有人包含只有短短三行，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 consisted。
consist 意为“包含”，自那以后那份报告不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 consists。
consist 意为“包含”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯包含只有短短三行”，此处为不定式 to consist three short lines only。
consist 意为“包含”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1978 年之前就有人包含过，故用过去完成时 had consisted。
consist 意为“包含”，那份报告说“包含只有短短三行这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 consisting three short lines only 作主语。
consist 意为“出在”，叔叔说的是“万一那份报告真出在就一个词和一个日期”，if 从句里用一般现在 consists of one word and a date。
consist 意为“出在”，老手们的规矩是“随它出在就一个词和一个日期”（let it consist of one word and a date），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
consist 意为“包含”，后来的那份报告每个夜晚都照例出在就一个词和一个日期，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 consists。
consist 意为“包含”，那份报告在 1981 年在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人包含只有短短三行，用一般过去式 consisted 叙述。
consist 意为“包含”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要包含只有短短三行，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，那份报告替所有人包含只有短短三行；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（consisted three short lines only）
多年以后，那份报告仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（consists three short lines only）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯包含只有短短三行这件事本身。（to consist three short lines only）
早在 1965 年就有人包含只有短短三行，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had consisted three short lines only）
那份报告说过，替所有人包含只有短短三行这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（consisting three short lines only 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它出在就一个词和一个日期，以后再也不要提起。（let it consist of one word and a date）
answers: In 1971 the report consisted three short lines only for the whole place, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the report still consists three short lines only without a word of thanks without being asked.
My mother said later that to consist three short lines only at all was the part nobody had expected.
The report had consisted three short lines only long before 1978, and the line in the poster for August proves it.
Consisting three short lines only for the whole place, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it consist of one word and a date without a word of thanks and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 consist 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the report consisted three short lines only for the whole place, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the report consists three short lines only without a word of thanks whenever the theatre asks.
Consisting three short lines only for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the report ever consists of one word and a date without a word of thanks before the August rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second report consists of one word and a date for the whole place every night, asking nothing about the past.
The report consisted three short lines only again in 1981, and this time nothing was written down.
